description: 𝐇𝐞𝐃𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐧𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐆𝐚𝐳𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐤! – 𝟎𝟗.𝟎𝟓.𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟒 𝐢𝐬 𝐚 𝐩𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐜 𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐲, 𝐞𝐧𝐣𝐨𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐞𝐧𝐝! For our next gathering we invite the infamous soundsystem crew from brussels: Gazmatek! This night we will be taken on a cosmic journey in the realms of the underground. A mix of tekno, mental tekno, acidcore, hardtek, tribe, acid tekno, psydub and zenon! This gathering will take place in the small room of the Chinastraat. Sound provided by Chinastraat, artists by Gazmatek & HeDon. _______________________________________ ARTISTS A-Z 𝑨𝑳𝑩𝑰𝑶𝑽𝑰𝑿 (𝑳𝒊𝒗𝒆) 𝑫𝑨Ä𝑵𝒀𝑨 (𝑳𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒊𝒏𝒔𝒕𝒓𝒖𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒔) 𝑵𝑶𝑪𝑰𝑫 (𝑽𝒊𝒏𝒚𝒍) 𝑺𝑯𝑴𝒀𝑪𝑲𝑩𝑳𝒀𝑪𝑲 (𝑳𝒊𝒗𝒆) 𝑺𝒀𝑹3𝑵 𝑻𝑬𝑲𝑲𝑶 (𝑳𝒊𝒗𝒆) 𝑻𝑬𝑹𝑨𝑷𝑬𝑼𝑻𝑬𝑲 (𝑽𝒊𝒏𝒚𝒍) _______________________________________ 09 . 05 . 2024 23:00 - 07:00 _______________________________________ Wave 1: €10 (excl. service fee) Wave 2: €13 (excl. service fee) Wave 3: €16 (excl. service fee) Doorsale: TBA, if available Artwork by Ellen de Ridder _______________________________________ 18+ Chinastraat 1 Gent www.chinastraat.be  Danse Gand
